The '''Mon Torri system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Msst sector/Legends|Msst sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mon Torri]].
